app.name: MediFirstCard
app.tagline: Your emergency info, one glance away
app.disclaimer: Educational prototype (course 040333215). Not a medical device. Do not use for diagnosis or treatment.

auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Log in
auth.passwordShort: Password must be at least 8 characters

consent.title: Consent
consent.intro: Before you start, please tell us how MediFirstCard may use your information.
consent.healthData: I consent to MediFirstCard collecting, storing and displaying the health information I enter (blood type, allergies, medical conditions, medications and medical documents) for the purposes of (1) showing the emergency information I select on my lock screen and to the people I choose to share it with, and (2) keeping my medical documents for my own use. I understand this information is self-reported and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.
consent.aiProvider: I consent to images of the documents I scan being sent to third-party AI services (Google Gemini and SCB 10X Typhoon) for text extraction. I understand that these providers process the images under their own terms and may use them to improve their services, and that I may decline this and enter document details manually.
consent.contact: I have informed my emergency contacts that their name and phone number are stored in this app and may be shown to rescuers.

card.title: Emergency Card
card.emptyHint: Add your name, blood type, allergies and an emergency contact so rescuers can help you fast.
card.qrHint: Rescuers can scan this QR code to open your card
card.rescuerNote: This is exactly what a rescuer sees when they scan your QR code or open your link.

lockScreen.deviceHint: If your lock screen shows only an icon, change the phone setting: Settings → Lock screen → Notifications → show content / Details (on Samsung phones). The app cannot change this for you.
lockScreen.title: Lock-screen card
lockScreen.exposureWarning: Anyone holding your phone can read the fields you show here, even when locked. Show only what could save your life.
lockScreen.shown: The card is pinned to your lock screen
lockScreen.hidden: The card is not on your lock screen
lockScreen.permissionDenied: Notifications are turned off. Allow them in Android Settings to show the card.
lockScreen.howItWorks: The card is shown as a pinned notification that stays visible on the lock screen until you turn it off.
lockScreen.nothingToShow: Turn on at least one field with data

profile.title: Emergency profile
profile.flagsHint: Shown to rescuers as critical conditions
profile.notesHint: Anything else a rescuer should know
profile.saveFirst: Save the basics first, then add your lists below.

allergies.noneKnownShown: Shown on your emergency card and lock screen.
allergies.emptyHint: Medicines, foods or other things you react to. Rescuers see this list first.
allergies.title: Allergies
allergies.needSubstance: Enter the substance in Thai or English

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.emptyHint: Add chronic conditions such as diabetes, epilepsy or heart disease.
conditions.needLabel: Enter the condition in Thai or English

medications.title: Medications
medications.name: Medication name
medications.emptyHint: Add regular medications, especially ones a rescuer must know about.

contacts.title: Emergency contacts
contacts.name: Name
contacts.informedConsent: I have told this person their name and number are stored here
contacts.emptyHint: Add someone rescuers can call. Their number appears on your card with a Call button.
contacts.invalidPhone: Enter a valid Thai phone number (9–10 digits starting with 0)
contacts.invalidPriority: Priority must be a number from 1 to 5

records.emptyHint: Scan a medical certificate, prescription or lab result to keep it safe here.
records.deleteConfirm: Delete this document? This cannot be undone.
records.reviewHint: Fields marked in red were hard to read. Please check and correct them before saving.
records.notMedical: This does not look like a medical document. You can still save it with your own details.

share.title: Share with a clinician
share.hint: Create a temporary link so a doctor can view the documents you choose. The link expires automatically and you can revoke it any time.
share.passcodeHint: Tell the clinician the passcode separately. 5 wrong tries revoke the link.
share.linkReady: Send this link to the clinician
share.noRecords: Add a document first to share it.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.emptyHint: You will be notified here when someone views your emergency card or opens a shared link.

kinds.share_revoked: A shared link was revoked after too many wrong passcodes

more.title: More
more.serverUrlHint: Where the app sends data. Change only for testing.

security.lockedOut: Too many wrong PINs. Log in again.
security.pinHint: Asked every time the app opens.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.withdrawHint: Withdrawing revokes all share links. Your data stays until you delete your account.
privacy.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw consent and revoke all share links?
privacy.deleteHint: Permanently deletes your profile, documents and links.
privacy.deleteConfirm: Delete your account and all data? This cannot be undone.
privacy.dataProtection: Your health data is encrypted on the server. Only you can see it, plus rescuers you show your card to.

errors.serverWaking: Waking up the server (free hosting) — this can take up to a minute…
errors.future_date: Date cannot be in the future
errors.image_blurry: The photo is not clear. Please retake it in good light.
errors.offline: You are offline. Changes are saved and will sync automatically.
errors.server_unreachable: Cannot reach the server. Check the Server URL in More.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet or the Server URL under More.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.permissionCamera: Camera access is needed to scan documents.
errors.permissionPhotos: Photo access is needed to pick a document.
errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Please log in again.
errors.tooLarge: The image is too large (max 10 MB).
errors.callFailed: Could not open the phone dialer.
